items.title: Sadie Goodson Interview, 1984-12-12
items.q: The old boy would go to rock and roll, he'd go to play in the rock and two with it.

ctx.x: About a half hour. What would happen if you ran into, did you ever run into any storms when you were going across? Well it'd get rough sometimes.
The old boy would go to rock and roll, he'd go to play in the rock and two with it.
Were there times when they wouldn't go out because the weather was too bad?
